basic_info.description: Spectacular Nob Hill flat remodeled and completed with permit in 2019 featuring two bedrooms and gorgeous en-suite baths with Ann Sachs tile. Primary bedroom featuring a decorative fireplace, must-see custom-built walk-in closet with floor to ceiling storage. Open living-dining area with an inviting sit down, handcrafted, 8-foot walnut top kitchen island. Beautiful La Cornue gas range and hood. Butler's pantry with Liebherr refrigerator and Fisher Paykel appliance drawers, and custom cabinets. Speaker system in the living room, bathrooms, and backyard. Laundry room with sink and custom cabinetry. Two bonus storage rooms at basement level. Spacious outdoor deck, and a large tranquil private landscaped garden with fruit trees (cherry, Meyer lemon, lime, orange, peach, and nectarine) and city views ideal for entertaining and al fresco dining. One car parking at nearby Grace Cathedral or Masonic Auditorium garage prepaid for one year is included.
